user.title: OpenLigaDB Configurator
user.description: Select the type of sensor you want to create.

league.title: Configure League Table

team_league_select.description: Select a competition for your team and the season. You can edit the season; other competitions are discovered automatically for that season.

team_select.title: Select Team
team_select.description: Select your team by name and OpenLigaDB team ID from the list.
